[app_spec] spec.rainfire-missions.mission-authoring — SPEC: RFM mission-authoring backend (CRUD + lifecycle state machine, ABAC own-scope, grounded in existing missions table) (status: done, access: 0)
    SPEC: RFM mission-authoring backend (P5). Grounded in the EXISTING missions table
(base 001_backend_schema.sql, extended through migration 179: mission_type
individual|business, business_directory_id, categories mig 133, FTS GIN mig 108,
funding triggers mig 135/138, payout columns mig 179). Extends the existing RFM
handler surface (donate.rs, nearby_missions.rs) — NOT greenfield.

GOAL: authenticated mission creators author + edit + lifecycle their RFM missions
(create draft → publish → pause → close), writing the existing missions table.

API CONTRACT (Axum 0.8.9, iron-will-api, RFM handler module):
- POST   /api/rainfire-missions/missions            create (draft) → MissionId
- PATCH  /api/rainfire-missions/missions/{id}        edit (owner-only)
- POST   /api/rainfire-missions/missions/{id}/publish  draft→active
- POST   /api/rainfire-missions/missions/{id}/pause     active→paused
- POST   /api/rainfire-missions/missions/{id}/close     →closed (terminal)

REQUEST FIELDS (CreateMission): title (1..200), description (1..5000), category_id
(FK matrix/mig133), goal_cents (i64, 100..=100_000_000 == $1-$1M, matches donate.rs
bounds), mission_type ('individual'|'business' CHECK), optional business_directory_id
(required iff mission_type='business'), optional cover image (R2 key → §MEDIA_TOKEN_ONLY:
response returns media_token, NEVER raw URL).

INVARIANTS:
- AUTHZ: ABAC PDP 'rainfire_missions:missions:write' scope=own (mig 232/258/259);
  edit/lifecycle owner-only (creator user_id == token user_id, anti-IDOR via
  token-derived subject — NOT a body field). §ABAC_MATRIX.
- STATE MACHINE: draft→active→paused⇄active→closed; closed is terminal; no skip.
  Loophole: status transition guarded server-side (no client-supplied status).
- RLS: §HYPERDRIVE_RLS BEGIN→SET LOCAL app.user_id→query→COMMIT.
- VALIDATION at edge into typed newtypes (goal_cents bounds, title len) — §illegal_states.
- §FULL_PLATFORM_SLUG: rainfire_missions everywhere; §RUST_STRICT (no unwrap/expect/panic);
  §MICRO_FILE ≤100 LOC per handler file (foo.rs + foo/).

VERIFY (3-witness + tests): SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo check -p <crate> exit 0;
nextest: create-bounds-reject, owner-only-edit-deny (IDOR), state-machine-illegal-
transition-reject, draft-not-publicly-listed property tests; clippy clean.

NOT IN SCOPE (separate cards): mission-search (FTS, mig 108 — already indexed),
mission-updates-feed (activity stream), donation settlement (money-path gated).
[app_spec] spec.ironmail.gmail-clone-ecosystem-email — IronMail = Gmail-clone (NO SMTP), all authenticated IWI users, To/CC/BCC (BCC hidden). Gmail layer = THIN shell: NEW send-API+user-auth+fanout+BCC-guard; REUSE user-service email-lookup (resolver) + comms-data/ironmail store (PG+Scylla). Not yet built. (status: todo, access: 0)
    RESOLVER REUSE FINDING (verified 2026-06-24, shrinks the IronMail Gmail-layer build):
The 'recipient resolver' the Gmail layer needs is ALREADY mostly built — do NOT build a new identity directory.
EVIDENCE: user-service exposes email->user lookup: crates/services/user-service/src/user_internal_read.rs has get_user_by_email (internal read). user_settings/privacy.rs carries a searchable_by_email privacy flag (the directory respects discoverability). The email-bearing user + org tables are in migrations 001_backend_schema.sql + 176_organizations.sql.
SO: the IronMail recipient-validity step = call user-service get_user_by_email (or the equivalent internal read) per To/CC/BCC entry, honoring searchable_by_email. valid IWI identity -> deliver; not found / not searchable -> reject. This is REUSE, not a new directory.
REVISED Gmail-layer build (smaller than the first LLD): the NEW pieces are (1) send/reply/forward API + To/CC/BCC DTO, (2) sender USER-auth via IronGate PASETO v4.public (the existing ironmail/auth.rs is service-auth), (3) envelope fan-out 1->N, (4) BCC privacy guard. The recipient resolver REUSES user-service email lookup. The persistence tier REUSES comms-data/ironmail (repo/chain/body + PG mig 298 + Scylla mig 016).
NET: ~4 new files + reuse of user-service lookup + reuse of comms-data store. Confirms owner no-over-engineering direction: almost everything exists; the Gmail layer is a thin auth+fanout+privacy shell over two existing services.

[app_spec] spec.b2b2c-lead-relay-medium — B2B2C medium = jacobs_ladder_marketing lead-relay: business -> dashboard (relay_token, lead-gated, opt-in, quota) -> PEP resolves to user -> surfaces in consumer Soundbak DM as a BUSINESS MESSAGE; consumer PII shielded by relay_token. NOT IronMail, NOT peer DM. (status: todo, access: 0)
    B2B2C COMMUNICATION MEDIUM (owner question 2026-06-24, evidence: migration 234 jacobs_ladder_marketing lead system).
THE MEDIUM = the jacobs_ladder_marketing LEAD-RELAY system, bridging a business -> the consumer Soundbak DM as a BUSINESS MESSAGE, gated on LEAD GENERATION. The relay_token is the privacy keystone. NOT IronMail (user<->user ecosystem email), NOT a peer social DM.
FLOW:
1. Business composes from the DASHBOARD (dashboard-service lead-inbox widget). It addresses an OPAQUE relay_token — NEVER the consumer real email/phone/identity (mig 234 header: business host NEVER sees raw user contact).
2. LEAD GATE: a message reaches a consumer ONLY if a lead row exists (one stable lead per user x business). No lead -> no thread -> no message. Lead generated when the consumer expresses interest.
3. PEP middleware resolves relay_token -> user_id to find the real consumer. user_id is PROTECTED; business-side queries go through a masked business-lead view that EXCLUDES user_id.
4. The lead-conversations row external_thread_id links the lead to the consumer SOUNDBAK DM conversation. The message surfaces in the consumer DM section as a BUSINESS MESSAGE (distinct sender-kind from a peer DM).
GUARDRAILS (anti-spam, already in mig 234): 4 vendor-locked channels, explicit opt-in per (lead x channel), instant revocation (status=revoked), daily message quota per tier, spam-report cascade -> account review, unsubscribe cascade + mandatory unsubscribe_url, relay-token rotation history.
WHAT EXISTS vs BUILD: the lead tables + relay_token + external_thread_id + masked business view EXIST (mig 234). NEEDS: the BUSINESS-MESSAGE sender-kind rendering in the soundbak DM section (consumer sees it flagged as business, not peer) + the dashboard send wired through external_thread_id -> soundbak DM. Soundbak DM bodies -> Scylla is the soundbak scylla-dms-schema-reuse card.
§FULL_PLATFORM_SLUG NOTE: the LIVE physical table names (jacobs_ladder_marketing lead tables) still carry the short-form prefix in the DB schema; per §FULL_PLATFORM_SLUG SQL-literal exemption a code/SQL literal must match the live name until the coordinated table-rename ships — but all prose + identifiers use full jacobs_ladder_marketing. File the table-rename as a follow-up.
